current_prompt.body:
DETERMINE whether the list L = {71, 97, 54, 56, 44, 158, 45, 58, 82, 135, 113, 117, 86, 40, 12, 185, 63, 50, 111, 72, 90, 109, 61, 13, 92, 60, 91, 35, 114, 94, 105, 26, 15, 51, 102, 118, 76, 32, 108, 23, 22, 134, 83, 43, 64} can be partitioned into 15 disjoint triples (a_i, b_i, c_i) such that a_i + b_i = c_i for each triple.
IF possible, PROVIDE one complete example of such a partition.

current_plan.body:
IDENTIFY all triples (a, b, c) from the list L where a + b = c.
FORM a collection of candidate triples.
SEARCH for a set of fifteen disjoint triples that together cover every element of L.
IF a covering set is found THEN
    SELECT one covering set as the example partition.
    OUTPUT the example partition.
ELSE
    OUTPUT a statement that no such partition exists.
ENDIF
